title: pm-dispatch: release is an explicit act — clear the assignee and post a `Release:` line whenever a card leaves a session's hands, so `pm:queue` never carries an assignee and `pm:dispatched` always does
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) from the maintainer's 2026-09-05 design discussion on issue ownership. Self-triaged `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`, governed (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` + `references/state-machine.md`).

## The gap

Ownership has an explicit entry (assign + `Claim:`) and no explicit exit. A card leaves a session's hands in four ways today — re-routed to another lane, handed back on `premise_still_valid: false`, abandoned when a flight dies with no takeover, or moved across lanes — and in each the assignee field keeps saying "someone owns this" after nobody does. The patrol rows that read the field (H1 dispatched-without-assignee, H24 queued-with-assignee) then report residue as if it were a live half-state, and a seat reading the list view sees a taken card that is free.

## What this card does

One rule, two lines, line-neutral on both files (both at headroom 0 — fold, never raise):

1. `SKILL.md` state machine section: **release is an explicit act** — whoever moves a card out of ownership clears the assignee and posts a line beginning `Release:` (session ID, the reason from the four above, and where the card went: the new label state or lane); the next owner claims afresh. A `pm:queue` card must have no assignee; a `pm:dispatched` card must have one (the H1/H24 readings become definitional).
2. `references/state-machine.md`: the same two facts on the releasing side, beside the existing applier/remover lines.

Not in scope: a new patrol row for a `Release:` newer than the last `Claim:` while the field is still set (a follow-up for `check-half-states.mjs` once the rule is on `main`), and any change to the claim's spelling (ruled 2026-08-11).

## Serial

`SKILL.md` (811/811, table pin 342) and `state-machine.md` (42/42) are in no flight since PR #15732 landed; member 5 of #15379 touches `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md` only. Governed ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review at contract tier, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge.

## Dedup

REST enumeration 2026-09-05T10:3xZ, `state=all` sorted by update (1,200 items, 797 issues; positive control #14768 hit): no card names a release act or the assignee's exit.
